== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-punishingone-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Punishing One (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 17 August 2019): The game text changes: “-3” is now set upright. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of the bronze disc.

The whole disc image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
